v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Sapiéntia * ædificávit sibi domum, míscuit vinum et pósuit mensam, allelúia.
text.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, * she hath mingled her wine, she hath also furnished her table, alleluia.

text.la: Angelórum esca * nutrivísti pópulum tuum, et panem de cælo præstitísti eis, allelúia.
text.en: Thou feddest thine Own people * with Angels' food, and didst send them bread from heaven, alleluia.

text.la: Pinguis est panis * Christi, et præbébit delícias régibus, allelúia.
text.en: Out of Christ His bread shall be fat, * and He shall yield royal dainties, alleluia.

text.la: Sacerdótes sancti * incénsum et panes ófferunt Deo, allelúia.
text.en: The Priests shall be holy; * for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer, [therefore they shall be holy], alleluia.

text.la: Vincénti dabo * manna abscónditum, et nomen novum, allelúia.
text.en: To him that overcometh will I give of the hidden manna, * and will give him a new name, alleluia.

text.la: Fratres: Ego enim accépi a Dómino quod et trádidi vobis, quóniam Dóminus Iesus, in qua nocte tradebátur, accépit panem, et grátias agens fregit, et dixit: Accípite et manducáte: hoc est corpus meum, quod pro vobis tradétur: hoc fácite in meam commemoratiónem.
text.en: Brothers: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus, the same night in which he was betrayed, took bread. And giving thanks, broke, and said: Take ye, and eat: this is my body, which shall be delivered for you: this do for the commemoration of me.

v.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, alleluia.

r.la: Et ádipe fruménti sátiat te, allelúia.
r.en: And filleth thee with the finest of wheat, alleluia.

text.la: Ego sum * panis vivus, qui de cælo descéndi: si quis manducáverit ex hoc pane, vivet in ætérnum, allelúia.
text.en: I am the living Bread Which came down from heaven; * if any man eat of this Bread, he shall live for ever, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui nobis sub Sacraménto mirábili passiónis tuæ memóriam reliquísti: tríbue, quǽsumus, ita nos Córporis, et Sánguinis tui sacra mystéria venerári; ut redemptiónis tuæ fructum in nobis iúgiter sentiámus:
text.en: O God, under a marvelous sacrament you have left us the memorial of thy Passion; grant us, we beseech thee, so to venerate the sacred mysteries of thy Body and Blood, that we may ever perceive within us the fruit of thy Redemption.
